PROPERTIES.player_hint_1_en: Look at Brenda: every square she could still use shares a row or column with row 5, column 8. So nobody else can stand at row 5, column 8, or Brenda would have nowhere to go. Look at Celeste: every square she could still use shares a row or column with row 7, column 7. So nobody else can stand at row 7, column 7, or Celeste would have nowhere to go. Brenda and Celeste can only use columns 7 and 8 between them, so nobody else can be in those columns. The same kind of reasoning rules out a few more squares. Gilbert is now the only person who can still go in row 3. So Gilbert (G) must be at row 3, column 5. Cross out his row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_2_en: Celeste and Ezra can only use rows 7 and 8 between them, so nobody else can be in those rows. Duncan is now the only person who can still go in column 1. So Duncan (D) must be at row 5, column 1. Cross out his row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_3_en: With the rows and columns of Gilbert and Duncan crossed out, only one square is left for Brenda that fits her clue ("She was beside the shelf in the Ticket Office."). So Brenda (B) must be at row 6, column 8. Cross out her row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_4_en: With the rows and columns of everyone placed so far crossed out, only one square is left for Celeste that fits her clue ("She was beside the lamppost."). So Celeste (C) must be at row 8, column 7. Cross out her row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_5_en: With the rows and columns of everyone placed so far crossed out, only one square is left for Ezra that fits his clue ("He was exactly one column east of Vivian."). So Ezra (E) must be at row 7, column 3. Cross out his row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_6_en: With the rows and columns of everyone placed so far crossed out, only one square is left for Faye that fits her clue ("She was in the Waiting Room, but not beside a trashcan."). So Faye (F) must be at row 4, column 6. Cross out her row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_7_en: Who can be the person beside a sign in Duncan's area? Only Vivian, because nobody else can still reach a square that fits Duncan's clue ("Someone else in his area was beside a sign."). That rules out Vivian's other squares. So Vivian (the victim) must be at row 2, column 2. Cross out her row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_8_en: With the rows and columns of everyone placed so far crossed out, only one square is left for Ada that fits her clue ("She was in the Ticket Office or the Taxi Rank."). So Ada (A) must be at row 1, column 4. Cross out her row and column. Duncan is the only person in the Platform with Vivian, so Duncan is the murderer!
